Dave unfolds a cardboard box and gets the net shown above. In the figure, the areas of two of its faces are shown. What is the total surface area of the box?
worked_solution:
The net shown corresponds to a rectangular prism. The surface area of our prism consists of $2$ squares (base and top) and $4$ rectangles (side faces). 

Therefore, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Surface area} & =2\times (\text{Area of the base})+4\times (\text{Area of the side}) \\  & =2\times 4+4\times 6 \\  & =8+24 \\  & =32\,{\text{ft}}^{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
